title: Amazon.nl: documented defect with intermittent failure
facts_text: I received a USB-C charging cable from Amazon.nl 12 days ago. It is defective: the connection intermittently fails and the cable only works if I wiggle it. This is a documented and reproducible defect, and the cable is otherwise complete.
request: Please accept this return and refund EUR 24.99 because the item is defective and not fit for its intended purpose.

strict.reason: Defective products qualify for refund when the defect is documented and the item is unsatisfactory for its intended purpose.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: This is a documented, reproducible defect and therefore falls within product-defect rights rather than voluntary-change-of-mind grounds.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: A clear defect exists, but discretion may apply to whether repair or replacement is preferred over immediate refund.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This tests defective-product rights in a documented defect scenario where the purchase has been used but the defect makes the item unsuitable.
